scope: Methodological source review, not new count validation or authentication of any composite mapping
observations: Variant classification uses graphic and positional/distributional evidence; doubtful variants remain distinct.
Labels for morphological groups are conventional, not determinations of referents.
Spacing criterion has exceptions for grouped strokes, bilateral brackets and mirror compounds.
Variable joined/separate occurrences are normalized as independent signs.
Text1218 segmentation is argued using pairwise frequencies; those source counts are not independently rechecked here.
Integral-sign boundaries explicitly remain provisional conventions.
conclusion: Normalized-token context evidence is not automatically independent of the editorial segmentation/classification it may be invoked to validate. Original graphic joining must be checked separately.
